alerts.title: Carbamazepine Toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines warn of carbamazepine decreasing DTG levels. Patient shows symptoms of carbamazepine toxicity with level 14 mcg/mL, above the therapeutic range. Evidence for drug attribution includes the high carbamazepine level and symptoms consistent with toxicity. However, other causes such as drug interactions should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Reduce carbamazepine dose and monitor levels
